headline: Apartment rents have risen in these districts of Baku
summary: Apartment prices are rising in new buildings and on the secondary market, with rental increases also observed. The housing price index rose 8.4% in the third quarter of 2026 compared with a year earlier.
why: Housing prices and rents reflect household purchasing power and construction activity, which matter for local banks and property developers.
